title: the MotP Plane of Elemental Air
audit_comment: the Plane of Elemental Air, printed pp. 31-36, the whole chapter: the hospitable-plane doctrine with the four border gradations (Smoke, Ice, Lightning, Vacuum), the 1,000-yard sighting, the 1-in-20-per-12-hours encounter check with its three-way split, the d12 phenomena table (cloud banks through the maelstrom and the Prime vortex), the WSG-adapted high-winds table with the 80-mph verbal cutoff and the 1d8-per-10-mph impact damage, the d20 pocket table with the sixteen pocket types, the d8+d12 encounter chart, the invisible natives, and the features (Yan-C-Bin, Akadi, Bahamut's citadel, the djinn landholds, the hooks and bubbles) - magic as the inner planes in general (p. 35).

consts.name: dcwAirSightingYards
consts.comment: the sighting distance in the plane of Air is 1,000 yards - about twice a clear Prime day; infravision fails (as in all inner planes), smell-tracking is foiled by the chaotic winds.

consts.name: dcwAirEncounterDenom
consts.comment: travelers in the plane of Air have a 1-in-20 chance of an encounter every 12 hours; roll: 1-20 elemental phenomena, 21-40 elemental pocket, 41-00 creature encounter.

consts.name: dcwAirPhenomenaDieSides
consts.comment: the d12 phenomena table: cloud banks, high winds, sirocco, rain storm, lightning storm, snow storm, maelstrom, dust storm, hail storm, and the vortex to a Prime Material plane.

consts.name: dcwAirPocketTableDie
consts.comment: the d20 elemental pocket table - all sixteen other inner-plane types drift as pockets in the passive plane of Air, from earth (1-2) through mineral (20).

consts.name: dcwAirChartDieSides
consts.comment: the Air encounter chart is a d8+d12 roll (2-20): 2 type I demons, 10 air elementals, 11 djinni, 12 invisible stalkers, 20 monadic devas - the 2 and 20 unique-powers slots.

consts.name: dcwAirWindCutoffMPH
consts.comment: magical spells with verbal components cannot be cast when the wind rises above 80 mph; the high-wind impact damage is 1d8 per 10 mph of wind speed against a hard surface.

consts.name: dcwAirMaelstromEscapeFt
consts.comment: the maelstrom (the tornado eating its own tail) cannot be escaped short of moving faster than 2,000 feet per turn, magical winds, outside rescue, or leaving the plane; high wind lasts 1d10 hours and prevents encounters during that time.

consts.name: dcwAirVortexDenom
consts.comment: the temporary vortices to a Prime Material plane: most last 2d10 subjective days, only one in 50 lasts longer; the Prime-side opening is severe weather, several miles above the ground.

bools.name: dcwAirHospitable
bools.comment: the plane of Air is the most hospitable inner plane to Prime planar life: the medium can be breathed and is excellent for travel; its beings are the most easily summoned and controlled.

bools.name: dcwAirBordersGrade
bools.comment: the border gradations: thicker and warmer toward Smoke, cooler with ice crystals toward Ice, rain clouds and ozone toward Lightning, thinning to the airless state toward Vacuum.

bools.name: dcwAirNativesInvisible
bools.comment: most Air-native creatures are invisible (only a 10% chance of a dust-outlined silhouette); they keep invisibility even when attacking; they are immune to weather, wind, lightning and cloud/mist spells - but trapped in complete vacuum they save vs. spell or perish.

bools.name: dcwAirDjinnLandhold
bools.comment: the djinn landhold: an earth pocket 1,000 yards to several miles across, about 1,000 djinn plus 1d10 jann and 1d10 elemental servants under a maximum-hit-point sheik; caliphs rule within two days' travel with six viziers; messenger-relay alert.
